definitions: A ruler over various Turkic and Mongol peoples in the Middle Ages.
Synonym of fonduk (“inn or hotel in Middle Eastern contexts”).

entries.title: List of He-Man and the Masters of the Universe characters

blocks.text: The Masters of the Universe franchise, created in 1981 as a toyline by American company Mattel, contained many characters in its various iterations as a toyline, the television series He-Man and the Masters of the Universe, a German series of audioplays, The New Adventures of He-Man, He-Man and the Masters of the Universe (2002), Masters of the Universe: Revelation and He-Man and the Masters of the Universe (2021) and the films The Secret of the Sword, He-Man & She-Ra: A Christmas Special, Masters of the Universe (1987), and Masters of the Universe (2026).

Khan is a surname of Turkic and Mongolian origin, used as a title in various global regions, and today most commonly found in parts of the Indian subcontinent, Iran, Eastern Europe, Uzbekistan and Russia.
